phase: Phase 3 (overall registry field; VX-880 and VX-017 arms)
population: T1D with impaired hypoglycemic awareness and severe hypoglycemia
primary_endpoint: Part A: adverse events from infusion through study end (at least 5 years); Parts B/C: insulin independence and absence of severe hypoglycemic events 1 year after achieving insulin independence; Part D: adverse events from VX-017 infusion through study end (at least 5 years)
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2026-09-01 (status verified 2026-08); estimated enrollment 57; no results section posted. Part D lists VX-017 safety follow-up; registry phase is the overall record field and should not be presented as evidence of outcomes. Confirm actual site availability and eligibility with the study.

Official record last posted 2024-12-11 (status verified 2024-12); estimated enrollment 2; no results section posted. A publication follows one participant through 14 months. Registry status may be stale; confirm site availability and eligibility with study contacts.

primary_endpoint: Safety and serious adverse events through 24 months; change in peak C-peptide during mixed-meal tolerance test from baseline to day 90
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2026-10-09 (status verified 2026-10); actual enrollment 7; no results section posted. Vertex reported in March 2025 that the study did not meet its efficacy endpoint and VX-264 would not advance; mechanism remains unresolved. Confirm site availability and eligibility with study contacts.

intervention: Autologous chemically induced pluripotent stem-cell-derived islets (CiPSC islets)
population: People with type 1 diabetes; the publication reports one participant; registry enrollment not independently verified
primary_endpoint: Feasibility; registry endpoint details not independently verified
known_limitations: Official page access was blocked in this review. The official history index indicated a version dated 2026-01-28; current status, enrollment, and results-posted state remain unverified. The Cell paper reports a preliminary phase-I analysis in one patient.

primary_endpoint: Adverse events through Month 24; planned Cohort 2 C-peptide change from baseline to Month 6 (no Cohort 2 participants enrolled)
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2022-03-24 (status verified 2022-02); actual enrollment 19; results posted. Termination reason: insufficient functional product engraftment. Registry status is historical; no direct human oxygenation measurement or definitive biological mechanism is established by this record.

modality: Perforated open macroencapsulation with vascular ingrowth
population: Adults with type 1 diabetes and hypoglycemia unawareness
primary_endpoint: Incidence of adverse events in Cohort 1; Cohort 2 C-peptide AUC change from baseline to Week 26
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2024-12-03 (status verified 2024-11); actual enrollment 49 and results posted. Open device permits vascular and immune-cell ingrowth; immunosuppression is used. The published 17-person and 10-person reports are related program groups, not independent trials.

intervention: Sernova Cell Pouch with donor islets
modality: Prevascularized implantable scaffold (not an immune-isolating device)
primary_endpoint: Device-related adverse events through 365 days after islet transplant; tissue survival and glycemic outcomes are secondary endpoints
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2026-02-25 (status verified 2026-02); estimated enrollment 17; no results section posted. Protocol describes prevascularization followed by donor islet transplantation under systemic immunosuppression; registry status does not establish clinical benefit.

intervention: ENC-201-CED ENCRT with primary human donor islets
population: Adults with type 1 diabetes receiving islet infusion
primary_endpoint: Device-related adverse events through Day 134; secondary explant containment and fibrosis assessment after Day 120
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2026-03-11 (status verified 2026-03); estimated enrollment 10; no results section posted. The registry is a safety/feasibility protocol, not evidence of reported efficacy or non-fibrotic engraftment.

modality: Anti-CD3 immune modulation for Stage 2 onset delay
population: Non-diabetic relatives aged 8-49 at high risk with multiple islet autoantibodies and dysglycemia
primary_endpoint: Rate of new clinical diabetes per 100 participant-years during follow-up; median 745 days (range 74-2683)
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2020-08-05 (status verified 2020-07); actual enrollment 76 and results posted. One 14-day infusion course; endpoint is progression to clinical Stage 3, not reversal.

modality: Anti-CD3 immune modulation for recent-onset Stage 3 beta-cell preservation
population: Children aged 8-17 with Stage 3 T1D diagnosed within 6 weeks, at least one islet autoantibody, and measurable stimulated C-peptide (peak >=0.2 pmol/mL)
primary_endpoint: Change in 4-hour MMTT C-peptide ln(AUC+1) from baseline to Week 78
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2024-04-24 (status verified 2023-08); actual enrollment 328 and results posted. Randomized 217 teplizumab/111 placebo; 296 completed (195/217 and 101/111). Primary ITT analysis used multiple imputation.

intervention: Teplizumab confirmatory study for recent-onset Stage 3 T1D
primary_endpoint: Region-specific Week 52 outcomes: HbA1c and days without prandial insulin in US/non-EU; MMTT-stimulated C-peptide plus HbA1c and insulin use in EU
known_limitations: FDA-required confirmatory study after accelerated approval; official record last posted 2026-10-13 (status verified 2026-10); estimated enrollment 723; no results posted. Regional endpoints differ, and registry status is not evidence of benefit.

intervention: Autologous polyclonal regulatory T-cell adoptive immunotherapy
modality: Cell therapy for immune tolerance research
primary_endpoint: Phase 1 safety and feasibility of adoptive Treg infusion
known_limitations: Official record last posted 2018-07-11 (status verified 2018-06); actual enrollment 16 and results posted. Representative early program for future immune-tolerance review; registry record does not establish efficacy.
